description: This source file defines the Startup class for the OrchardCore.Media module, configuring services and middleware related to media management, image processing, permissions, deployment, indexing, shortcodes, and security features within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: Startup
classes.description: Main startup class configuring media services, image processing, permissions, and middleware for OrchardCore.Media.

classes.name: MediaCacheStartup
classes.description: Configures permissions and navigation for media cache features.

classes.name: DeploymentStartup
classes.description: Sets up deployment sources and steps for media.

classes.name: MediaIndexingStartup
classes.description: Configures indexing handler for media fields.

classes.name: TextIndexingStartup
classes.description: Adds text providers for media files with .txt and .md extensions.

classes.name: ShortcodesStartup
classes.description: Registers shortcodes for media and asset URLs.

classes.name: SecureMediaStartup
classes.description: Enables secure media features, permissions, and handlers.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Configures dependency injection services for media, image processing, permissions, and related features.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Sets up middleware pipeline for media file handling, image processing, and static files.

methods.name: GetMediaPath
methods.description: Constructs the media storage path based on shell options and settings.
